sql: select * from health.cdc_county_overdose_deaths fetch first 3 rows only

select "year","month", indicator, predicted_value, data_value from health.cdc_state_drug_overdose_deaths where state='US' and indicator like 'Number of Drug Overdose Deaths' and "year" in ('2025','2026') fetch first 30 rows only

select count(*) total_counties, sum(case when a.c is not null and b.c is not null then 1 else 0 end) both_known, sum(case when a.c is not null and b.c is not null and b.c>a.c then 1 else 0 end) rose, sum(case when a.c is not null and b.c is not null and b.c<a.c then 1 else 0 end) fell, sum(case when a.c is not null and b.c is not null and b.c=a.c then 1 else 0 end) same, sum(case when a.c is null or b.c is null then 1 else 0 end) unknown from (select fips, cast(provisional_drug_overdose as double) c from health.cdc_county_overdose_deaths where monthendingdate='2025-03-31') a join (select fips, cast(provisional_drug_overdose as double) c from health.cdc_county_overdose_deaths where monthendingdate='2026-03-31') b on a.fips=b.fips

select st_abbrev, countyname, fips, monthendingdate, provisional_drug_overdose from health.cdc_county_overdose_deaths where monthendingdate in ('2025-03-31','2026-03-31') and ((st_abbrev='OH' and countyname in ('Butler','Hamilton')) or (st_abbrev='KY' and countyname='Campbell') or (st_abbrev='NM' and countyname='Rio Arriba')) order by fips, monthendingdate

select count(*) total_counties, sum(case when a.c is not null and b.c is not null and b.c>a.c then 1 else 0 end) rose, sum(case when a.c is not null and b.c is not null and b.c<a.c then 1 else 0 end) fell, sum(case when a.c is not null and b.c is not null and b.c=a.c then 1 else 0 end) same_, sum(case when a.c is null or b.c is null then 1 else 0 end) suppressed_either from (select fips, cast(provisional_drug_overdose as double) c from health.cdc_county_overdose_deaths where "year"='2025' and "month"='3') a join (select fips, cast(provisional_drug_overdose as double) c from health.cdc_county_overdose_deaths where "year"='2026' and "month"='3') b on a.fips=b.fips

select st_abbrev, countyname, fips, "year", provisional_drug_overdose from health.cdc_county_overdose_deaths where "month"='3' and "year" in ('2025','2026') and ((st_abbrev='OH' and countyname in ('Butler','Hamilton')) or (st_abbrev='KY' and countyname='Campbell') or (st_abbrev='NM' and countyname='Rio Arriba')) order by fips, "year"

select sum(case when b.c>a.c then 1 else 0 end) rose, sum(case when b.c<a.c then 1 else 0 end) fell, sum(case when b.c=a.c then 1 else 0 end) same_, count(*) n from (select fips, cast(provisional_drug_overdose as double) c from health.cdc_county_overdose_deaths where "year"='2025' and "month"='3' and st_abbrev='OH' and provisional_drug_overdose is not null) a join (select fips, cast(provisional_drug_overdose as double) c from health.cdc_county_overdose_deaths where "year"='2026' and "month"='3' and st_abbrev='OH' and provisional_drug_overdose is not null) b on a.fips=b.fips
select count(*) n, sum(case when provisional_drug_overdose is null then 1 else 0 end) supp from health.cdc_county_overdose_deaths where "year"='2026' and "month"='3'
select "year", total_population from census.acs_population where county_fips='35039' order by "year" desc fetch first 3 rows only

select max(cast(provisional_drug_overdose as double)/p.total_population*100000) mx from health.cdc_county_overdose_deaths d join (select county_fips, total_population from census.acs_population where "year"='2024') p on p.county_fips=lpad(d.fips,5,'0') where d."year"='2026' and d."month"='3' and d.provisional_drug_overdose is not null and p.total_population>=1000
